title: Streaks + lightweight gamification
description: Surface a small streak indicator for daily visits and a weekly 'your week on Bluesky' recap (posts, new followers, top-engagement post). v0 is client-local (no atproto lexicon, no PDS writes), humane-first (no loss-aversion, no push, hidden before day 2), and feature-flaggable.
acceptance_criteria: AC-A1 Qualifying visit: app foregrounded ≥30s with ≥1 feed item rendered records the current local day; duplicate same-day sessions do not increment.
AC-A2 Consecutive-day increment: qualifying visit on day N after day N-1 increments streak by exactly 1 and persists across restarts.
AC-A3 Silent grace day: one missed day is forgiven — streak is unchanged on the next visit; grace-day indicator only visible in the explainer sheet, never in the header.
AC-A4 Break rule: after two or more consecutive missed days, next qualifying visit resets streak to 1.
AC-A5 Anti-manipulation: timezone changes never decrease streak and never allow >1 increment per 20 wall-clock hours (UTC monotonic guard).

AC-A6 Placement: native home header near drawer avatar; web left-rail under profile row. Flame glyph + integer. accessibilityLabel='{n}-day Bluesky streak' (Lingui). testID='streakIndicator'. Home tab only.
AC-A7 Hidden states: indicator is not rendered when logged out, opted out, or when current streak < 2.
AC-A8 Tap opens Dialog (bottom sheet native / modal web) showing current streak, longest-on-device, plain-language rules, grace-day status, and a link to Settings. No 'share streak' CTA.
AC-A9 Storage: streak lives only in persisted device storage; no atproto record, no new lexicon, no bsky.social/PDS network request includes streak data.
AC-A10 Multi-account: streak keyed by DID; account switch swaps display; logout retains locally, account removal clears it.
AC-B1 Weekly recap generation: on Monday ≥06:00 device-local, if user had ≥1 qualifying visit in prior ISO week, generate recap and pin a card atop Notifications tab.

AC-B2 Recap metrics: posts authored (composition TBD — one number or split), net new followers (clamped to 0 in UI, true delta retained for analytics), top post (own post with highest likes+reposts+replies).
AC-B3 Tapping card navigates to full-screen 'Recap' route (Navigation.tsx) using Layout.Screen with platform-consistent back affordance; embeds top post via existing post components.
AC-B4 Empty states: zero-posts swaps top post for neutral copy ('No posts this week — that's fine.') with no suggestion to post more; zero/negative follower delta renders as 0.
AC-B5 Dismissal: close button hides the card for that weekId; 4-week rolling history accessible from Settings → Activity & recap → Past recaps.
AC-B6 Auto-expiry: card disappears 7 days after first appearance regardless of dismissal.
AC-B7 No push, no email, no OS widget in v0; no code path enqueues a push or writes to notification settings.

AC-B8 Data sourcing: computed on-demand from app.bsky.feed.getAuthorFeed and app.bsky.actor.getProfile for the signed-in DID only; no new lexicon; API failure shows compact error + manual Retry, auto-retry capped at 2/hr.

AC-B9 Accessibility + i18n + motion: card/screen render under RTL, long Lingui strings, screen reader (each metric independently labeled), reduced-motion (no celebratory autoplay), large text (no clipping).
AC-B10 Moderation fallback: if computed top post is deleted/hidden/taken-down, fall back to next-highest-engagement; if none, use AC-B4 empty copy.
AC-B11 Setting 'Show weekly recap': when off, client does not compute recap inputs at all.

AC-B12 No PDS write: recap values computed on-device; no derived payload sent to servers; any analytics events carry only booleans (recapViewed/recapDismissed/recapTopPostTapped), never metric values.
AC-X1 New Settings sub-screen 'Activity & recap' under Content & Media with two toggles (streak, recap), both default ON; toggles take effect within 1s with no restart.
AC-X2 Toggles persist per-account locally; survive reinstall only via OS backup; not synced via atproto preferences in v0.
AC-X3 First install after ship: no onboarding modal, NUX, or interstitial for either surface — passive discovery only.
AC-X4 No numerical badges on app icon, bottom tab bar, or drawer item introduced by this feature (preserves existing notification-badge semantics).
AC-X5 All user-facing strings wrapped with msg() / <Trans> and added to locale files; no hardcoded English.
AC-X6 Feature-flaggable via an existing gating mechanism so it can be remotely disabled without a release.
out_of_scope_v0: Streak freezes, purchasable saves, streak restoration
Sharing a streak or recap (profile, DM, external)
Badges, trophies, levels, XP, cumulative achievements
Push notifications and email for the recap
Server-side streak record, new lexicon, or PDS persistence
Recap metrics beyond the three specified (no impressions, engagement rate, profile views)
Streak indicator on tabs other than Home
guardrails: G1 No loss-aversion UI: no 'about to break' warnings, no countdowns, no 'don't lose your streak' pushes.
G2 Silent grace day: missed day forgiven without header callout (prevents Duolingo 'you saved your streak!' loop).
G3 Low visual weight: flame glyph + small integer; no animation, no haptic on increment, no sound.
G4 Hidden below 2 days so new users are not primed into a commitment on day 1.
G5 No social pressure: no leaderboards, no friend streaks, no share mechanic. Streak is personal, local, invisible to others.
G6 No passive-engagement metrics in recap (no time-spent, no scrolls).
G7 No re-engagement gamification for churned users: weeks with 0 visits produce no recap.
G8 Default-on with plainly-labeled prominent opt-out (one screen deep + in-sheet link in the streak explainer).
G9 Client-local only: no new lexicon, no PDS record. Feature is fully reversible without protocol debris.
G10 No dark-pattern resurfacing: if user turns either surface off, we never re-prompt to re-enable (no NUX, tooltip, or dialog).
ac_source: product-owner + designer + architect consolidation (no prior Trello comments; drafted from ticket description)
